dailyK.notes: Daily K supports MA, volume, candle, breakout, MACD and KDJ calculations.

weeklyK.notes: Weekly K supports weekly moving-average bullish alignment.

volumeBreakoutInputs.notes: Daily high/low/open/close/volume can support previous-high, platform and red-candle checks.

macdInputs.notes: MACD can be computed from close series; provider does not need to supply MACD directly.

kdjInputs.notes: KDJ can be computed from high/low/close series; provider does not need to supply KDJ directly.
